description: Generated from phase package manifests, detected audio assets, and benchmark-authored audio provenance.

audio.strategy: Generated browser synthesis for Phase 1: each played note starts two Web Audio oscillators (triangle fundamental plus quiet sine partial) through a gain envelope and low-pass filter. Tests use an injectable null adapter, so they do not require audio hardware.

generatedSources.name: Phase 1 generated piano voice
generatedSources.license: Candidate-authored code; no recorded samples or external audio assets.
generatedSources.notes: Honest fallback-quality piano-like synthesis with velocity-sensitive gain/filter envelope, release, sustain, and deterministic voice ownership.

notes: No bundled recorded piano samples are included or claimed in Phase 1.
Panel controls are decorative presentation state only; only keybed/computer-key/MIDI note input and MIDI/keyboard sustain affect the generated voice.
